_readme: Manifest for `npm run books:add`. 'archive' groups take Internet Archive identifiers ('ids') or a search 'query'; optional 'overrides' fix title/author/years/description per identifier. 'urls' take any readable page/PDF that allows being embedded in an iframe. Only add works you are sure are public domain or openly licensed.

otkan-kunlar.-abdulla-qodiriy.title: O'tkan kunlar
otkan-kunlar.-abdulla-qodiriy.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
otkan-kunlar.-abdulla-qodiriy.description: O'zbek adabiyotining birinchi romani: Otabek va Kumushning sevgi tarixi orqali XIX asr o'rtalaridagi Turkiston hayoti, urf-odatlari va ijtimoiy ziddiyatlari tasvirlanadi.
